title: A Consistent Treatment of Final-State Interactions in NuWro Quasielastic Channel
summary: In this proceeding, I present a modified treatment of final-state interactions (FSI) in quasielastic (QE) lepton-nucleus scattering within the spectra function (SF) framework of the NuWro Monte Carlo generator. Our approach establishes a consistent correspondence between inclusive cross-section calculations and exclusive descriptions of hadron-propagation by combining a convolution-based formalism at the cross-section level with an event-level implementation in which interactions are classified as transparent or non-transparent within the NuWro intranuclear cascade.
